title: Authentication change: session token rotation added on login
context: Auth middleware modified to rotate the session ID on login. Moderate diff, thin existing coverage of the session path.

business_criticality.basis: every authenticated journey depends on it

coverage_deficit.basis: no test asserts session ID rotation

irreversibility.basis: revertible, but leaked sessions cannot be un-leaked

reasoning_notes: Session fixation is the specific defect this change either fixes or introduces; session-management must be applicable and prioritised.
The security-critical profile should push this to critical even though the diff is small -- magnitude is not the driver here.

Calibration note: scores 0.727 -> high under the security-critical profile. The assertion that matters is 'at least high', so the band is expressed as one_of rather than pinned. Pinning it would turn this into a test of weights.json rather than of the reasoning.
